notes: The text runs «عن حذيفة، والأعمش، عن سعد بن عبيدة»: read as co-transmitters at one level, one group. The source readings split this into two routes (HKG) or keep one (RWY); flagged for review.
«حذيفة» stands twice (after طلحة, and the Companion at the end); occurrences 1 and 2 keep them apart.
